task_reconstruction.official_task: Raise throughput at airport security, keep passengers satisfied, and hold cost down.

section_map.summary: Summary names three aims and two queueing phases.
Phase 2 specified as an Erlang queue of order 4.
Scan lanes, not document desks, move the waiting time.
Three queue disciplines compared on missed flights.
Recommendations written as a letter to managers.

contributions.summary: Two phases in series, with the second fed by the first.
A one-parameter mix of first come and departure priority.

dependency_graph.handoff: the service rates that the hourly flow is run through
the passenger stream that the virtual queue reorders

assumptions.summary: Passengers join the shortest queue, and pre-check is set aside.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Service rate 0.09465 after a t-test on two officers.
Arrival rates 0.077244 and 0.10882016, both chi-squared tested.

models.summary: Two queues in series, Erlang order 4.
One normal distribution per flight, summed.
Priority as a convex mix of two times.

verification.summary: Ten runs at each of three disciplines.

results_trace.summary: One added scan lane beats four added document desks.
Phase-2 wait falls to 26.0189 seconds at 120 minutes early.
Ten percent more scan ability cuts wait by 81.2 percent.

writing_logic.summary: Four problems numbered before any model.
Two additions of equal cost compared, then the bottleneck named.
The policy is delivered as a letter.

language_observations.summary: Three aims in one sentence, culture called quantified.
The fit is accepted by placing the statistic next to its critical value.
Weaknesses listed in one line each, undefended.

visualization_observations.summary: Table 2 compares three staffing rows across seven arrival rates.
Figure 13 gives ten runs of missed flights under two disciplines.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Three disciplines on one metric make the fairness claim checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Recompute the Erlang mean and variance from one parameter pair and compare with the printed pair.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Phase 2 is an Erlang service of order 4.
One normal distribution per flight, then summed.
Rates estimated and tested before use.
Ten runs per discipline, statistic beside critical value.
Earlier arrival cuts the mean wait.
Five scan lanes need three document desks.
Ten percent input changes mapped to output changes.
Assumptions numbered and used as rules.
Erlang mean and variance kept despite inconsistency.
Two flow rates kept side by side.
One scan lane priced at four desks.
Queue discipline set by one acceptability factor.

unresolved_questions: The Erlang mean is printed as alpha and the variance as alpha times beta squared. Both kept.
Flows of 723 and 721 passengers per hour are both printed. Neither is corrected.
The printed page header says of 20 while the PDF has 30 pages.
